name: Transfer Value Determinants Dataset
description: Dataset containing 2502 football player transfer-market observations across seasons 2019-2023. Includes performance metrics, physical attributes, club context, and transfer values. Used as the primary ML training dataset (Dataset 2) in the FAIR Data Science football player market value prediction experiment. Originally published on Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0.

distribution.name: Nisanov_final_data.xlsx
distribution.description: Source Excel workbook with 5 sheets (one per season 2019-2023). Sheets 2020-2023 lack club_performance, relegation, and success_or_not columns.

recordSet.name: transfer_value_observation
recordSet.description: Transfer-market observations across football seasons 2019-2023. 2502 rows total. club_performance, relegation, and success_or_not are only present in the 2019 sheet (1157 NULL values for those columns in later seasons).

field.name: player_name
field.description: Player full name. One encoding-corrupted value corrected during normalisation.

field.name: position
field.description: Player field position (e.g. Striker, Defensive Midfield, Left Winger).

field.name: nationality
field.description: Player nationality.

field.name: club_name
field.description: Name of the player's football club during the observed season.

field.name: age_then
field.description: Player age at the start of the observed season.

field.name: age_now
field.description: Player age at time of data collection.

field.name: club_performance
field.description: Club league performance indicator (signed integer). Only available for the 2019 season. NULL for seasons 2020-2023. Values range from -10 to 13 in the 2019 sheet.

field.name: relegation
field.description: Whether the player's club was relegated that season. Only available for 2019. NULL for seasons 2020-2023. Stored as integer 1 (true) or 0 (false) in DBRepo.

field.name: success_or_not
field.description: Transfer outcome indicator. Values: -1 (unsuccessful), 0 (neutral), 1 (successful). Only available for 2019. NULL for seasons 2020-2023.

field.name: total_games
field.description: Total games played in the season.

field.name: assists
field.description: Total assists recorded in the season.

field.name: penalty_kicks
field.description: Total penalty kicks taken in the season.

field.name: total_minutes
field.description: Total minutes played in the season.

field.name: total_goals
field.description: Total goals scored in the season.

field.name: height
field.description: Player height.

field.name: start_value
field.description: Transfer market value at the start of the season in EUR. 17 values are missing in the source data; stored as 0.0 in DBRepo due to NOT NULL constraint.

field.name: end_value
field.description: Transfer market value at the end of the season in EUR. 2 values are missing in the source data.

field.name: delta_value
field.description: Difference between end and start transfer value (end_value minus start_value) in EUR.

field.name: value_0_mln
field.description: Transfer market value at the start of the season in millions EUR.

field.name: value_end_mln
field.description: Transfer market value at the end of the season in millions EUR. TARGET VARIABLE for ML prediction.

field.name: value_delta_mln
field.description: Difference between end and start transfer value in millions EUR.
